P.expected_type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)) (h_H001 : E.Nonempty) (h_H002 : IsCompact E), dimH (cyl n E) = dimH E + 1

correspondence.explanation: Parameters n:ℕ and E:Set(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) range over exactly all original n≥0 and Euclidean subsets. H001 is precisely nonemptiness and H002 precisely compactness, with no further assumptions. W n is the Euclidean coordinate space indexed by the n original coordinates and one final coordinate; its squared distance is the sum of the n squared coordinate differences plus the last squared difference. Thus cyl n E is exactly E×[0,1] under the original Euclidean identification, not a max-norm product. This works when Fin 0 is empty as well. Native dimH is the specified extended-nonnegative supremum definition, and T001 identifies the unnormalized cover measure. The conclusion is exactly dim_H(E×[0,1])=dim_H(E)+1 in that codomain; T005 proves finiteness rather than assuming it. No second metric representation or conversion theorem is required.
